### Watch a form InputValidator

`watch_mascot_validator()` binds a `shinyvalidate::InputValidator` to a mascot
with built-in defaults for `"valid"` and `"invalid"` (including `"1 field
needs attention"` or `"<n> fields need attention"` when `map$invalid` omits
`status`). Pass `map` only for the keys or fields you want to change:

```{r watch_mascot_validator-call, echo = FALSE}
htmltools::tags$pre(htmltools::tags$code(paste0(
  'iv <- shinyvalidate::InputValidator$new()\n',
  'iv$add_rule("email", shinyvalidate::sv_required())\n',
  'iv$enable()\n',
  'obs <- mascot::watch_mascot_validator(\n',
  '  "helper",\n',
  '  iv,\n',
  '  map = list(invalid = list(bubble = mascot_bubble("Check the form.")))\n',
  ')\n',
  '# Call obs$destroy() if you need to stop watching before the session ends.'
)))
```

Validators with no registered rules leave the mascot unchanged. Passing an empty
`list()` for `"valid"` or `"invalid"` also leaves that state unchanged. Inside a
Shiny module, pass the module's local mascot id, the same as in
`update_mascot()`.

```{r watch_mascot_validator-mistakes, echo = FALSE}
if (!in_studio()) guide_mistakes_html("watch_mascot_validator", studio_character)
```
